caption:
Health insurance shopping season is here. 🏥
ACA open enrollment is on. KFF's tracker points to a median premium increase of about 15% for 2027, after about 20% this year.
On the federal exchange, Dec. 15 is the last day to enroll for coverage starting Jan. 1.
Have you checked your plan costs yet?
